sections.title: Morning Shift — Team 1 (06:30 – 14:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 3 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone, 2 x Bodycam, 2 x Radio.
Arrived at the office. Going to debrief with Night Shift and then gear up to go and patrol.
Heading out on patrol towards Aotea Square. Whilst patrolling we will be conducting welfare checks on businesses.
Starbucks and Queen St McDonald's all clear. Localito and 77 Convenience stores have just opened. Continuing to Aotea Square.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Commencing a sweep of the area.
Heading towards Federal St via Wellesley St.
Arrived at the corner of Victoria and Federal St. Welfare checks completed from:
Heading towards Wyndham St via Federal St.
Standing by at the corner of Wyndham and Albert St. Welfare check on Cathedral Church all clear, no issues, standing by for security presence.
Albert Mart all clear. Continuing towards Lower Albert.
Arrived at Lower Albert, on standby at Commercial Bay for security presence.
No issues at Commercial Bay, heading to Gore St.
Gore St all clear, on standby at Auckland Harbour Suites.
Full sweep Fort St, welfare check Chargrill, Jo & Joe's, Evan's Kebabs, KFC, no issues.
High St all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Freyberg, Chancery Square, Kitchener St, all clear, no issues to report.
Checking in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Aotea Square full sweep complete, all clear, no issues.
Patrolling up Albert St going towards 77 Convenience store.
Check in 77 Convenience / Coffee Club, no issues to report.
Response call to Banh-Mi shop due to vagrant blocking entrance and scaring customers.
Arrived on site, kindly asked vagrant to change locations, he complied, no further issues.
Full sweep Durham St, all clear, no issues.
Welfare checks Chemist Warehouse, Kathmandu, Macpac, no issues.
Response call for Queen St McDonald's due to individual sleeping inside premises.
Arrived on site, asked individual to leave the premises, individual tried arguing with us.
Individual left the premises, no further issues.
Welfare checks Look Sharp, no issues.
Full sweep Wyndham St, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep St Patricks Cathedral Sq, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Federal St, all clear, no issues.
On standby Commercial Bay showing security presence.
Commercial Bay no issues to report.
Responded to call from Hotel Debrett due to individual outside with drugs on table.
Arrived on site, asked individual to leave, individual complied, no further issues.
Check in Freyberg / Chancery Square, on standby showing presence.
No issues at Chancery Square / Freyberg.
Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone, currently on 2%.
Arrived at HQ charging Ops Phone, currently 1%.
Response call from Foot Locker due to a group of individuals stealing, seen running off to Lorne St.

Full swept Lorne St, Queen St Arcade and searched Queen St and also Britomart train station, could not find persons of interest. Also while searching for persons of interest, removed vagrants from Unichem entrance. Heading back to HQ to charge Ops Phone.
Break ended, morning shift concluded, handover complete.

sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:50 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Standing by charging Ops Phone and waiting for response calls.
Commencing patrols for upper Queen Street areas.
Full sweep Darby Street & Elliott Street.
Arriving at Aotea Square, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep Aotea completed, crossing over to Lorne Street for full sweep.
Sweep Rutland Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Full sweep Lorne Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Sweep Victoria Street West, all clear, no issues to report.
Sweep Albert Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Sweep Federal Street. Heading towards Queen Street and maintaining visible presence.
Commencing patrols for Lower Queen Street areas.
Sweep Victoria St West heading down to Queen Street, maintaining presence, and waiting for response calls.
Received a response call from Metropolis Hotel security requesting assistance for 2 residents fighting in the lobby and making a scene. Making our way over to Metropolis now.
Arrived at Metropolis Hotel, briefing with security guard about the situation. The 2 residents were a couple and both of them went back upstairs to their room, standing by maintaining presence.
Commencing patrols from Metropolis Hotel down Victoria St East.
Full sweep High Street, full sweep Vulcan Lane.
Full sweep Fort St, full sweep Fort Ln.
Sweep Custom Street East. Arrived Commercial Bay area, commencing full sweep.
Full sweep Commercial Bay, no issues to report.
Full sweep Lower Albert Street. Walking down to Queen Street through Victoria Street West.
Sweep Queen Street and Wyndham Street, welfare check on Chemist Warehouse, all clear, no issues to report. Welfare checks completed on stores, areas, and businesses below:
Standing by on Queen Street maintaining visible presence and waiting for response calls.
Heading back to Headquarters for floor checks.
Arrived at headquarters, commencing floor checks.
Heading back down to ground floor to commence patrols on upper street areas.
Doing one final patrol route for upper Queen Street areas.
Darby Street & Elliott Street sweep completed.
Full sweep of Aotea Square completed.
Sweep Victoria Street East / West, all clear, no issues to report.
Sweep Albert Street, all clear, no issues to report.
Walking down Wellesley Street West, standing by Queen St awaiting response calls.
Arrived at Headquarters, charging Ops Phone and standing by for calls.
Starting our 30 minute break and standing by for calls.
Afternoon shift completed, equipment handover completed.

sections.title: Night Shift (22:30 – 06:30)
items: Equipment received: 4 x Keys, 2 x Body Cameras, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Suiting up to start patrols. Commencing patrols on lower Queen Street.
Arrived at Durham St West. No issues seen thus far. Continuing down Queen Street.
Arrived at Vulcan Lane. Sweep was conducted in the area, no issues to report on. Moving along en route.
Shortland Street & Fort Street all clear. Low volume of civilians vacating Queen Street & areas nearby at this time. Continuing down towards TK Square to carry out checks.
Arrived at TK Square. Commencing sweep of the area as well as a welfare check at McDonald's Britomart.
Sweep completed. Spotted a few vagrants in the area looking for shelter. McDonald's staff have no issues to relay at this time. Heading back up through Fort Lane.
Fort Lane all clear. No concerns have come to our attention thus far. Moving along up High Street towards Chancery Square.
Arrived at Chancery Square. Commencing sweep of the area.
Chancery Square all clear. Standing by due to higher volume of civilians in the area compared to Queen Street.
All clear. No response calls in the meantime to respond to. Continuing patrols up High Street.
Victoria St East all clear. Moving on towards Lorne Street.
Lorne Street all clear. Continuing towards central city library for a sweep before heading back on Queen Street.
Central city library all clear. Vagrants sleeping outside the library but other than that no concerns in the area. Cutting through Rutland Street to head towards Aotea for a sweep of the area.
Arrived at Aotea Square. Area is busier than usual. Conducting sweep.
Area all clear. No issues despite the high volume of civilians vacating the area. Standing by awaiting response calls.
No issues to report on. Continuing down towards the Civic.
Arrived at the Civic. Standing by awaiting response calls before continuing en route.
All clear. No issues to attend to at this point in time. Continuing down Queen Street.

Arrived at McDonald's Queen Street for a welfare check. Staff had reported a vagrant coming inside standing around customers. Male was not present at time of arrival. Standing by to show security presence.
No sign of male vagrant. Area all clear. Staff have been advised to give us a call if he returns again. We will stay close by for now whilst continuing patrols. Heading down Darby Street.
Darby Street all clear. Ensured safety of staff at Darby considering they had an event earlier. No reports from them concerning any trouble they may have had. Continuing towards Elliott Street.
Elliott Street all clear, Atrium included. Zero to none activity in the area. Heading up towards Albert Street through Wellesley Street West.
Albert Street all clear. Low volume of footwork in the area. Continuing down Victoria Street West towards Queen Street.
Back on Queen Street. Heading to HQ for floor checks.
Full sweep Durham St, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Wyndham St, all clear, no issues.
Check in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, all clear, no issues.
Welfare checks Albert St Convenience store, no issues to report.
Welfare check marina guards, no issues.
On standby outside Andrew Andrew's due to hospo party, showing security presence.
No issues at Andrew Andrew's / Providor.
Full sweep Quay St, all clear, no issues.
Check in Britomart McDonald's / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues to report.
Check in Gore St, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Fort St / Wilson carpark, all clear, no issues.
Full sweep Freyberg / Chancery Sq / Kitchener St, all clear, no issues.
Check in corner of Lorne St / Wakefield, all clear, no issues.
Check in Aotea Square, all clear, no issues.
Check in Queen St McDonald's, no issues.
Heading back to HQ, charge Ops Phone, currently 10%.
Heading back out on patrols. Heading up Victoria St, all clear.
Check in 77 Convenience store, no issues.
Check in St Patrick's Cathedral Church, all clear, no issues.
Check in Chemist Warehouse / Kathmandu, no issues.
Check in Britomart McDonald's / Commercial Bay, all clear, no issues.
Check in Fort St / Wilson carpark, all clear, no issues.
Check in Chancery Square / Freyberg, no issues.
